content: Surarohon amna dugo yu Yerusalem woce suran togung

Oro Yudia provinsdecma amna auho Antiok bucin ohongmuya kombing tobic tobic suraro tonguc imongo ingoroc fandat inogung, “Son muyu Mösehon nongoru tanda godip soni maarut. Son ihoroc matoninganu wömai Kopotorocho son mafogic.”

Yu suraro ihoroc fandat inuya Pol orin Barnabas wo kombiunya angit maidina yuot mataho toup töhic tohoic togung. Ihoroc tuya suraroho ‘mata ngo tobiarut’ yongo Pol orin Barnabas orin amna auot inongmuya yu ‘mata tobic tobicha Yerusalem onguya aposel orin amna dugo yuot suran tonung’ yongo inong mudung.

Inong muuya yu uyap forosingga ongga Fonisia orin Samaria provins woce itongmuya kombing tobic tobic suraro wocin idungma inongburoc tongga inogung, “bumbumyi nano yu ihorocgon irotno ibanda Kopotorochon fat idang,” ihoroc inong tonguya suraro ambaracho woroc kombingga borongdedung.

Tuya amna torop Pol orin Barnabasot onggungma yu Yerusalem ongkungga aposel orin amna dugo wocin idungma yu yau fedung. Tongo Pol orin Barnabas yu Kopotorocho yuhon oburodec youp moröma togocma worochon fatno inogomoroc.
Woroc inunya kombing tobic tobic amna au farisihon toropdecma yu idongga kiringga yogung, “Bumbumyi nano yu muyu Mösehon nongoru sumboda itongitnung. Tongo yu muyu godibo maarut,” ihoroc yogung.
Ihoroc yuya aposel orin amna dugo yu mata woroc tobic tobicha suran togung.

Suran tongga mata koböc koböc yongga itmuya Pitaho ‘mata ta bödehun’ yongo idongga ingoroc inogoc, “Oröcnai, son urop kombingdeang, Kopotorocho osucgon ‘goc bumbumyi nano fatmata ogepma inia Yesuha kombing tobing imonung’ yongo noc erangga nanong mudoc.

Kopotoroc yu amnahon irot kombingbödengitac. Tongo yu Kunkun Yaru siuna bumbumyi nano ot ohuna nonu wo angmanaina tuctugo kombigomon, boinno sinom Kopotorocho Yuda nanoha kombihacma worochon toroc yu ihorocgon bumbumyi nanoha kombiuna yu yuhon torop idang.
Yuda nanohu o bumbumyi nanohu yu ambarac wömai Kopotorocho irotno tongsac tong imuna yuho yangamin torop tungu idang.
Worochai oro, sonu foro yaha sinom Kopotorochon toroc kiap anggiratmuya bumbumyi nano mepmo moröma imoc imocha yang. Mepmo wo wömai ombu sakungnonihu o nonihu non ambarac angit masumbodidomon.

Muno, nonu ingoroc kombing tobingidamon: Kopotorocho non Yesuhon madec ningbanagocmaha tongga nonu Kopotorocho yangamin nongnongo idamon. Woi non Yuda nanohu o bumbumyi nano, non ambarac uyap worocdecgon ongidamon.” Pitaho ihoroc yogoc.
Ihoroc yuna Pol orin Barnabas yu Kopotorocho yuhon oburodec youp moröma sinom bumbumyi nanodec togocma worochon fatno inunya suran togungma onggom songga mata worocha onggim sigung.
Fat woroc inongbödeunya Jemsho idongga mata ingoroc yogoc, “Oröc ori nocho mata yoya kombiarut.
Kopotorocho osuc bubumyi nanodecma owi amna au inoin fat eragocma worochon fatno wömai Saimontho yuna kombimon.
Oro Kopotorochon yong tuctuc amnani yu osuchagon Saimontho yogocma worochon docno yogung. Auma ingoroc irim toctocyi itac:
‘Kopotorocho yac, ‘Devithon morogoni yui böc guman mögocma woroc simbang. Wohong mit nocho ibara fauna böc guman mögocma wo wönggon temongma uuna Devithon toropni koing sonahing.
Nocho ihoroc toya owi amna abeiho wec idangma yu Morömaha yong yabinahing. O bumbumyi nano nocho era-gotma yu ihorocgon nakaha yabing tonahing.
Kopotoroc yu osucgon ‘ihoroc tangot’ yongo mata yong torop singdegoc.’ (Amos 9:11, 12)
“Worocha nocu ingoroc kombihat, nontho gendic nongoruhon mepmo bumbumyi nano Kopotorocha irot imongidangma yu imonintha.

Muno non komong yongburoc bapiya au ingoroc irim tonaya yuot ongoun: Goumo dogu kopot boyömpha öret socsochon sigungma woroc wömai yu naninga. O yu owi göra toninga. O arap bangaro tuptupyi woroc naninga. O ihorocgon arap nogotno wo imu fauna naninga.

Mösehon gendic ihorocnoho wömai osucgon sinom böcsa danong ongbödeuna owi amnaho kombingdeang. O Sabat danong wömai amna dugoho gendic wo fatmata yocyoc bucin embauya owi amna kombingbödeang.” Jems yu ihoroc yogoc.
Amna dugo yu bumbumyi suraroha yongburoc bapiya irim togung

Oro aposel orin amna dugo orin suraro ambarac yu irot tungu singmuya ‘amna au yu Pol orin Barnabasot Antiok bucin ongorut’ yongo yuhon bonipnodec amna au soworegung. Amna soworegungma woi, Yudas mano au Barsabas orin Silas, amna yaima yu kombig tobic tobic surarohon amna dugo idomoroc.

Suraroho amna torop woroc erangga mit bumbumyi nanohon yongburoc bapiya au ingoroc irim togung: ‘Sep ogep sinom, Non aposel orin surarohon dugo nonu bapiya ngo oröcnoni bumbumyi nanohon toropdecma sontha yongo irim tongo sinaya sonot Antiok o Siria o Silisia woce ongoun.
Non fat ingoroc kombigomon, amna auho nonthon bonip nonidecma yu sonot engmuya mata kanuya irot soni obukogoc. Oro amna wo wömai inoin irotgon tanda togung, nonu yu mainong mudomon.
Worocha tongga non ngo suran tongga ‘amna au sonot ongonung’ yongo irot tungu singmanaina amna au soworegomon. Ihoroc tonaya amna worocho oröcnoni Barnabas orin Pol yu sonot epnahing.
Amna ngo yu inoin itonggongno makokoregung. Muno, Yesu Duichon youpha tongga yu foyop itonggongo imu fadoc.
Nontho amna yai Yuda orin Sailas yu ‘yongburoc bapiya noni ngo inoin duc matadec tong koing totimoruc’ yongo inong munaya eptahamoroc.
Oro Yuda nanohon gendic nongoruha wömai Kunkun Yaruot nonot irot tungu singmanaina mata ingoroc tong koing togomon: Nontho mepmo au makamonin. Muno, ‘yapmu ngorocgon wömai sonu toninga’ yongo yamon.

Goumo dogu kopot boyömpha öret socsochon sigungma woroc wömai sonu naninga. O arap nogot naninga. O arap bangaro tuptupyi wömai naninga. O owi göra tongitninga. Oro sonu yapmu woroc matoninganu wömai sonu ogep itnahing. Mata docutno worocgon.’
Oro suraroho bapiya ihoroc irim tongga amna soworegungma imongo inong muuya tonggung. Tongga yu Antiok bucin ongkungga suraro feng suran tongo bapiya imogung.
Imuya suraroho wo embato kombingga oröc mata yong imogungmaha irot ogep kombigung.
Tuna amna yai Yudas orin Sailas yu Kopotorochon yong tuctuc mata yongidomoroc. Worocha tongga yu suraro inong fasun fasun youp tongga irotno tong koing togomoroc.
Ihoroc tongga yu sep youp toctoc au suraro ot woce idung. Tuna mit suraroho Yuda orin Sailas guram tong imongo ‘Morömahon irot gucnoho sodot itun’ yongo yu inong muuya böcnon onggomoroc.
Oro Pol orin Barnabas yui Antiokgon idinya amna orogoma auot Morömahon fatmata ogepma surarodec yong fandat inongidung.
Pol orin Barnabas irot tungu maidomoroc
Oro oipmonu Polho Barnabas inogoc, “Notu osuc böcsa danong itongo Morömahon fatmata fandat fandat youp tonggomotma ‘woce oröcnodi tingting idang’ yongo wönggon itongmadaina yatahamot.”
Ihoroc inuna Barnabas yu Jön mano auma Mak ‘yu yangada tongoda’ yongo kombigoc
mahong Pol yu Makot onggonga kombiuna angit maidoc. Wömai yaha Mak yu osuc yuot Pamfilia sae itongga youn fauya youpno angit matun bödegocmaha.
Worocha Polot Barnabasot yong osutmunya fuc tongga youp kondong wönggon matogomoroc. Tuna Barnabasho Mak yangauna ongga girang au sogida Saiprus woce onggomoroc.
O Pol yu ‘Sailasot itongoda’ yongo yu soworegoc. Suraroho ‘Morömahon irot gucnoho sodot idina itongurin’ yongo inong muuna onggomoroc.
Ongga yu Siria o Silisia gurocin itongmunya Yesuhon suraro woce idungma yu tongkoing tong imogomoroc.
